title: CREATE-MATTER@v1 output schema — cataloged create-matter capability (FR-A1-13 / R19, spaarke-ai-architecture-redesign-r2 task 042). Repo mirror of the sprk_analysisaction.sprk_outputschemajson this Action will carry once seeded (PENDING live sprk_analysisaction row — see infra/dataverse/inputschemas/create-matter-v1.input.schema.json header). Declaration order = streaming order: matter_name -> matter_description -> practice_area_suggestion -> matter_type_suggestion -> cited_refs. cited_refs minItems 1: an uncited matter proposal is invalid (ADR-039 grounded outputs). practice_area_suggestion / matter_type_suggestion are LABELS (never GUIDs) — the assistant resolves them to sprk_practicearea_ref / sprk_mattertype_ref via dataverse.read_query before the gated dataverse.create_record write (mirrors the create-task pattern of proposal-now, write-later under the ONE confirmation gate).

matter_description.description: Complete matter description grounded in the source documents: nature of the matter, parties, and the concrete details a matter owner needs.

practice_area_suggestion.description: Best-guess practice-area LABEL judged from the source material; empty string when not evident. Resolved to sprk_practicearea_ref at write time — never a GUID.

matter_type_suggestion.description: Best-guess matter-type LABEL judged from the source material; empty string when not evident. Resolved to sprk_mattertype_ref at write time — never a GUID.

cited_refs.description: The source references the proposal drew from (file names; session output ledger keys when the request names them).
